integrity: Theorems are supported by the written Fourier/PBH proof and reproducible integer-arithmetic checks; the 2011 generalized Petersen spectrum and published zero-forcing upper bound are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unweighted combinatorial Laplacian and independent coordinate actuators only; no exhaustive classification of all optimal placement sets; exact spectral equality must not be inferred from rounded numerics; specialist literature coverage has residual uncertainty.
title: Multiplicity-optimal consecutive outer actuators on every generalized Petersen graph
